edit.description: Edit an existing UTF-8 text file by replacing literal text. old_string must match the file exactly, character for character: copy it from your latest read of the file, keeping its spaces and indentation, without the line-number prefix. Keep old_string short: only the line or lines you change, plus a neighboring line if needed to make it unique. If the file has changed since you read it, read it again before editing.

arguments.old_string: Exact text copied from the latest read, without line numbers; keep it short
arguments.new_string: Replacement text; must differ from old_string

taskContract:
When you use edit:
- Copy old_string exactly from your latest read of the file: same spaces, indentation and punctuation, no line-number prefix. Never write it from memory.
- Keep old_string short: just the line or lines you change, plus one neighboring line only if needed to make it unique.
- After the file changes (your own edit, write or bash), read it again before the next edit.
- If edit fails, read the file again before retrying; never resend the same old_string.
